description: Returns which database Uptime Kuma stores its data in (sqlite, mariadb or embedded-mariadb), the SQLite file's size, and how many days of monitor history it keeps (keepDataPeriodDays). Uptime Kuma can only measure and shrink SQLite; for MariaDB the size is null.
name: getDatabaseInfo

canShrink.description: Whether shrinkDatabase does anything on this database

dbType.description: sqlite, mariadb or embedded-mariadb; null if Uptime Kuma did not say

keepDataPeriodDays.description: Days of heartbeats and daily statistics kept before the nightly cleanup deletes them; 0 keeps them forever. Change it with updateSettings.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the SQLite file; null for MariaDB

title: Get Database Info
